parsed.scene_description: An indoor retail aisle with black shelving units holding packaged goods. Colorful lanterns hang from the ceiling. A refrigerated display case is visible on the right.

objects.label: shelving unit
objects.observation: Black metal structure with multiple wire baskets and shelves holding packaged food items. Positioned centrally in the aisle.

objects.label: packaged goods
objects.observation: Boxes and bags of snacks placed on shelves and wire baskets. Some items are stacked vertically.

objects.label: lanterns
objects.observation: Colorful hanging decorations suspended from the ceiling. Shapes include round and teardrop forms.

objects.label: refrigerated display case
objects.observation: Glass-fronted unit on the right side of the aisle containing items inside.
